about: Curated list of established open-source solvers and tools for each analysis suite; every link and licence was checked on the retrieval date, and licences are as stated by each project.

cfd.name: SU2
cfd.what: Finite-volume CFD suite for compressible and incompressible RANS flow with adjoint-based shape optimisation, widely used for external aerodynamics.

cfd.name: OpenFOAM
cfd.what: General-purpose finite-volume CFD toolbox with a large library of solvers, turbulence models and meshing utilities.

cfd.name: OpenVSP / VSPAERO
cfd.what: NASA parametric aircraft geometry tool with the bundled VSPAERO vortex-lattice and panel solver for conceptual-design aerodynamics.

cfd.name: XFOIL
cfd.what: Classic panel method with coupled boundary layer for the design and analysis of subsonic aerofoils (lift, drag, transition).

cfd.name: PyFR
cfd.what: High-order flux-reconstruction solver for scale-resolving (LES/DNS) compressible flow simulations on GPUs and CPUs.

cfd.name: Gmsh
cfd.what: Finite-element mesh generator with a built-in CAD engine and post-processor, used to prepare meshes for CFD and FEA solvers.

cfd.name: CFL3D
cfd.what: NASA Langley structured-grid RANS solver, long used as a reference code for turbulence-model verification and validation.

fea.name: CalculiX
fea.what: Implicit and explicit 3D structural finite-element solver (static, dynamic, thermal, contact) with an Abaqus-like input format.

fea.name: Code_Aster
fea.what: EDF finite-element solver for structural mechanics, thermal analysis, dynamics, fatigue and fracture.

fea.name: NASTRAN-95
fea.what: NASA public release of the original NASTRAN structural analysis code, the ancestor of today's commercial Nastran solvers.

fea.name: MYSTRAN
fea.what: General-purpose linear finite-element solver that reads NASTRAN-style input decks for statics, modes and buckling.

fea.name: FEniCSx
fea.what: Finite-element computing platform for solving partial differential equations written in near-mathematical notation from Python or C++.

fea.name: Elmer
fea.what: Multiphysics finite-element package from CSC covering structural mechanics, heat transfer, fluid flow, electromagnetics and acoustics.

fea.name: pyNastran
fea.what: Python library for reading, writing and post-processing NASTRAN input decks and result files.

aeroelastic.name: SHARPy
aeroelastic.what: Nonlinear aeroelastic analysis package for very flexible aircraft, coupling geometrically exact beams with an unsteady vortex-lattice method.

aeroelastic.name: OpenAeroStruct
aeroelastic.what: Low-fidelity coupled aerostructural analysis and optimisation (vortex-lattice aerodynamics plus beam finite elements) built on OpenMDAO.

aeroelastic.name: Loads Kernel
aeroelastic.what: DLR software for quasi-steady and dynamic manoeuvre loads, unsteady gust loads and flutter analysis of flexible aircraft.

aeroelastic.name: MBDyn
aeroelastic.what: General-purpose multibody dynamics solver from Politecnico di Milano for mechanisms, flexible bodies and aeroservoelastic systems.

aeroelastic.name: NASTRAN-95
aeroelastic.what: NASA public release of the original NASTRAN structural analysis code, the ancestor of today's commercial Nastran solvers.

aeroelastic.name: preCICE
aeroelastic.what: Coupling library that connects separate fluid and structure solvers for partitioned fluid-structure interaction simulations.

aeroelastic.name: TACS
aeroelastic.what: Toolkit for the Analysis of Composite Structures: a parallel finite-element code for analysis and gradient-based design of thin-walled aerospace structures.

flightdyn.name: JSBSim
flightdyn.what: Six-degree-of-freedom flight dynamics model library used in simulators and for batch flight-mechanics studies.

flightdyn.name: AVL
flightdyn.what: Extended vortex-lattice program for aerodynamic and flight-dynamic analysis of rigid aircraft, including trim and stability derivatives.

flightdyn.name: OpenVSP / VSPAERO
flightdyn.what: NASA parametric aircraft geometry tool with the bundled VSPAERO vortex-lattice and panel solver for conceptual-design aerodynamics.

flightdyn.name: FlightGear
flightdyn.what: Open-source flight simulator used for pilot-in-the-loop evaluation and visualisation of flight dynamics models.

flightdyn.name: python-control
flightdyn.what: Python Control Systems Library for analysing and designing linear and nonlinear feedback control systems.

flightdyn.name: AeroSandbox
flightdyn.what: Python framework for aircraft design optimisation with built-in aerodynamics, propulsion, structures and performance models.

performance.name: SUAVE
performance.what: Stanford conceptual aircraft design environment covering aerodynamics, propulsion, weights and mission analysis for conventional and unconventional configurations.

performance.name: OpenAP
performance.what: Open aircraft performance model and Python toolkit for estimating thrust, drag, fuel consumption and emissions of common airliners.

performance.name: Aviary
performance.what: NASA aircraft analysis, design and optimisation tool built on OpenMDAO, coupling aircraft sizing with mission analysis.

performance.name: FAST-OAD
performance.what: Future Aircraft Sizing Tool for overall aircraft design: a framework for sizing and performance evaluation of transport aircraft.

performance.name: ADRpy
performance.what: Aircraft Design Recipes in Python: conceptual design and performance tools including design atmospheres and constraint analysis.

performance.name: AeroSandbox
performance.what: Python framework for aircraft design optimisation with built-in aerodynamics, propulsion, structures and performance models.

performance.name: JSBSim
performance.what: Six-degree-of-freedom flight dynamics model library used in simulators and for batch flight-mechanics studies.

rotorcraft.name: DUST
rotorcraft.what: Mid-fidelity aerodynamic solver from Politecnico di Milano using panels, lifting lines and vortex particles for rotorcraft and eVTOL configurations.

rotorcraft.name: FLOWUnsteady
rotorcraft.what: Vortex-particle interactional aerodynamics solver for rotors, propellers and multirotor aircraft.

rotorcraft.name: MBDyn
rotorcraft.what: General-purpose multibody dynamics solver from Politecnico di Milano for mechanisms, flexible bodies and aeroservoelastic systems.

rotorcraft.name: XROTOR
rotorcraft.what: Interactive program for the design and analysis of ducted and free-tip propellers and windmills.

rotorcraft.name: OpenFAST
rotorcraft.what: Aero-servo-elastic time-domain simulation framework for rotating blades and towers, developed for wind turbines.

rotorcraft.name: CCBlade
rotorcraft.what: Robust, fast and differentiable blade-element-momentum code for rotor aerodynamic performance.

propulsion.name: pyCycle
propulsion.what: Thermodynamic cycle modelling library for gas-turbine engine design and off-design analysis, built on OpenMDAO.

propulsion.name: T-MATS
propulsion.what: NASA Toolbox for the Modeling and Analysis of Thermodynamic Systems: Simulink blocks for gas-turbine engine performance and control studies.

propulsion.name: NASA CEA
propulsion.what: Chemical Equilibrium with Applications: NASA code for equilibrium composition and thermodynamic properties of combustion products.

propulsion.name: Cantera
propulsion.what: Chemical kinetics, thermodynamics and transport library for combustion and reacting-flow calculations.

propulsion.name: CoolProp
propulsion.what: Thermophysical property database for pure fluids, mixtures and humid air.

propulsion.name: TESPy
propulsion.what: Thermal Engineering Systems in Python: steady-state simulation of thermodynamic cycles such as heat pumps, refrigeration loops and power plants.

propeller.name: XROTOR
propeller.what: Interactive program for the design and analysis of ducted and free-tip propellers and windmills.

propeller.name: QPROP
propeller.what: Analysis program for predicting the performance of propeller and electric-motor combinations.

propeller.name: CCBlade
propeller.what: Robust, fast and differentiable blade-element-momentum code for rotor aerodynamic performance.

propeller.name: CCBlade.jl
propeller.what: Julia blade-element-momentum implementation for propellers and turbines with guaranteed convergence, suited to optimisation.

propeller.name: pyBEMT
propeller.what: Small Python blade-element-momentum model for estimating propeller thrust or turbine power.

propeller.name: XFOIL
propeller.what: Classic panel method with coupled boundary layer for the design and analysis of subsonic aerofoils (lift, drag, transition).

propeller.name: DUST
propeller.what: Mid-fidelity aerodynamic solver from Politecnico di Milano using panels, lifting lines and vortex particles for rotorcraft and eVTOL configurations.

fatigue.name: pyLife
fatigue.what: General Python library for fatigue and reliability: S-N curves, load collectives, rainflow counting and damage sums.

fatigue.name: py-fatigue
fatigue.what: Python package for cyclic stress (fatigue) analysis and cycle counting.

fatigue.name: fatpack
fatigue.what: Python package for fatigue analysis of measured data series, including rainflow counting and S-N damage.

fatigue.name: rainflow
fatigue.what: Python implementation of the ASTM E1049 rainflow cycle-counting algorithm for fatigue analysis.

fatigue.name: CalculiX
fatigue.what: Structural finite-element solver that also provides the stress fields and cyclic crack-propagation calculations used in fatigue assessments.

fatigue.name: Code_Aster
fatigue.what: EDF finite-element solver for structural mechanics, thermal analysis, dynamics, fatigue and fracture.

vibration.name: ROSS
vibration.what: Rotordynamic Open-Source Software: Python library for Campbell diagrams, critical speeds and unbalance response of rotating machinery.

vibration.name: SDynPy
vibration.what: Sandia structural dynamics Python library for modal test data, signal processing and vibration analysis.

vibration.name: CalculiX
vibration.what: Structural finite-element solver used here for natural frequencies, mode shapes and steady-state or transient dynamic response.

vibration.name: Code_Aster
vibration.what: EDF finite-element solver used here for modal analysis, rotating-machinery dynamics and forced vibration response.

vibration.name: Elmer
vibration.what: Multiphysics finite-element package used here for eigenmode and harmonic vibration analysis of structures.

vibration.name: pyNastran
vibration.what: Python library for reading, writing and post-processing NASTRAN input decks and result files.

acoustics.name: Acoular
acoustics.what: Python framework for acoustic beamforming and microphone-array processing to locate and quantify sound sources.

acoustics.name: NoiseModelling
acoustics.what: Tool for producing environmental noise maps over large areas using standard outdoor propagation methods.

acoustics.name: SU2
acoustics.what: CFD suite whose unsteady flow solutions provide the source data for aeroacoustic noise prediction.

acoustics.name: OpenFOAM
acoustics.what: CFD toolbox used to compute the unsteady flow sources that drive aeroacoustic noise predictions.

acoustics.name: PyFR
acoustics.what: High-order scale-resolving flow solver suited to computing the turbulent noise sources needed for aeroacoustics.

acoustics.name: OpenFAST
acoustics.what: Rotor aero-servo-elastic framework that includes an aeroacoustics module for blade noise.

thermal.name: Elmer
thermal.what: Multiphysics finite-element package from CSC covering structural mechanics, heat transfer, fluid flow, electromagnetics and acoustics.

thermal.name: code_saturne
thermal.what: EDF finite-volume CFD solver for single-phase flow with conjugate heat transfer and radiation.

thermal.name: OpenFOAM
thermal.what: General-purpose finite-volume CFD toolbox with a large library of solvers, turbulence models and meshing utilities.

thermal.name: ht
thermal.what: Python library of heat-transfer correlations for convection, heat exchangers, boiling and radiation.

thermal.name: CoolProp
thermal.what: Thermophysical property database for pure fluids, mixtures and humid air.

thermal.name: TESPy
thermal.what: Thermal Engineering Systems in Python: steady-state simulation of thermodynamic cycles such as heat pumps, refrigeration loops and power plants.

thermal.name: CalculiX
thermal.what: Finite-element solver used here for steady and transient heat conduction and coupled thermo-mechanical stress.

icing.name: OpenFOAM
icing.what: General CFD toolbox; its flow and Lagrangian particle-tracking solvers are common building blocks for droplet impingement and ice-accretion research codes.

icing.name: SU2
icing.what: CFD suite used to compute the airflow around clean and iced shapes as input to icing and performance-degradation studies.

icing.name: XFOIL
icing.what: Aerofoil analysis code used for quick estimates of how an iced section shape changes lift and drag.

icing.name: Gmsh
icing.what: Mesh generator used to remesh the geometry after each ice-growth step in multi-step icing simulations.

gear.name: MBDyn
gear.what: Multibody dynamics solver used for landing-gear drop, shimmy and ground-load simulations with flexible structures.

gear.name: Project Chrono
gear.what: Multi-physics engine with contact and tyre models, suitable for landing-gear touchdown and ground-handling dynamics.

gear.name: Simbody
gear.what: Multibody dynamics library for modelling articulated mechanisms such as retraction linkages and shock struts.

gear.name: OpenModelica
gear.what: Modelica environment for modelling oleo struts, tyres, brakes and actuation as coupled multi-domain systems.

gear.name: JSBSim
gear.what: Flight dynamics model with ground-reaction (gear contact, steering, braking) modelling for take-off and landing simulation.

crash.name: CalculiX
crash.what: Finite-element solver with nonlinear explicit dynamics, contact and plasticity for impact-type simulations.

crash.name: Kratos Multiphysics
crash.what: Multiphysics framework with nonlinear structural, contact and particle methods applicable to impact problems.

crash.name: Code_Aster
crash.what: EDF finite-element solver with nonlinear transient dynamics, contact and damage models.

crash.name: Project Chrono
crash.what: Multi-physics engine for multibody impact and contact dynamics.

crash.name: DualSPHysics
crash.what: Smoothed-particle hydrodynamics solver for violent fluid-structure impact such as water landing (ditching).

control.name: ArduPilot
control.what: Autopilot software for fixed-wing aircraft, multicopters, helicopters and VTOLs, with a software-in-the-loop simulator.

control.name: PX4 Autopilot
control.what: Flight control stack for drones and other unmanned vehicles, including estimators, controllers and simulation interfaces.

control.name: Paparazzi UAV
control.what: Long-running autopilot system for fixed-wing and rotary unmanned aircraft, widely used in research.

control.name: INAV
control.what: Navigation-focused flight controller firmware for fixed-wing and multirotor aircraft.

control.name: Betaflight
control.what: Flight controller firmware for multirotors with a focus on rate-loop performance and filtering.

control.name: python-control
control.what: Python Control Systems Library for analysing and designing linear and nonlinear feedback control systems.

control.name: JSBSim
control.what: Six-degree-of-freedom flight dynamics model library used in simulators and for batch flight-mechanics studies.

avionics.name: RTKLIB
avionics.what: Program package for standard and precise GNSS positioning, including RTK and PPP.

avionics.name: GNSS-SDR
avionics.what: Software-defined GNSS receiver that processes raw signal samples through to navigation solutions.

avionics.name: GTSAM
avionics.what: Factor-graph library for sensor fusion, inertial navigation and simultaneous localisation and mapping.

avionics.name: FilterPy
avionics.what: Python library of Kalman, extended, unscented and particle filters for state estimation and sensor fusion.

avionics.name: AHRS
avionics.what: Python toolbox of attitude and heading reference system algorithms such as Madgwick, Mahony and EKF.

avionics.name: MAVLink
avionics.what: Lightweight messaging protocol and code generator for communication between drones, onboard components and ground stations.

avionics.name: QGroundControl
avionics.what: Ground control station for flight planning, vehicle setup and telemetry of MAVLink-based aircraft.

hydmech.name: Hopsan
hydmech.what: Linköping University simulation environment for fluid power and mechatronic systems such as hydraulic actuators.

hydmech.name: OpenModelica
hydmech.what: Modelica compiler and simulation environment for equation-based modelling of multi-domain physical systems.

hydmech.name: Modelica Standard Library
hydmech.what: Standard component library for Modelica tools covering mechanical, fluid, thermal, electrical and control domains.

hydmech.name: MBDyn
hydmech.what: Multibody dynamics solver that includes hydraulic elements for actuators coupled to mechanisms.

hydmech.name: Project Chrono
hydmech.what: Multi-physics engine for gears, bearings, drivelines and other mechanical transmission dynamics.

electrical.name: PyBaMM
electrical.what: Python Battery Mathematical Modelling: physics-based lithium-ion cell models for performance and degradation.

electrical.name: liionpack
electrical.what: Battery pack simulation tool built on PyBaMM for series-parallel pack behaviour.

electrical.name: OpenConcept
electrical.what: Conceptual design toolkit in OpenMDAO for aircraft with electric, hybrid and other unconventional propulsion architectures.

electrical.name: OpenModelica
electrical.what: Modelica environment for modelling electrical machines, power electronics and distribution networks as system models.

electrical.name: SUAVE
electrical.what: Conceptual aircraft design environment with battery, motor and electric-network models for electric and hybrid aircraft.

fuelecs.name: CoolProp
fuelecs.what: Thermophysical property database for pure fluids, mixtures and humid air.

fuelecs.name: TESPy
fuelecs.what: Thermal Engineering Systems in Python: steady-state simulation of thermodynamic cycles such as heat pumps, refrigeration loops and power plants.

fuelecs.name: OpenModelica
fuelecs.what: Modelica environment for fuel, thermal-fluid and air-conditioning system models.

fuelecs.name: Modelica Standard Library
fuelecs.what: Standard component library for Modelica tools covering mechanical, fluid, thermal, electrical and control domains.

fuelecs.name: OpenFOAM
fuelecs.what: CFD toolbox whose volume-of-fluid solvers are used for fuel sloshing in tanks.

fuelecs.name: DualSPHysics
fuelecs.what: Smoothed-particle hydrodynamics solver suited to violent liquid sloshing in tanks.

fuelecs.name: Cantera
fuelecs.what: Thermodynamics and kinetics library for fuel property and combustion calculations.

composites.name: composipy
composites.what: Python library for composite laminate stress-strain, plate buckling and lamination-parameter optimisation.

composites.name: TACS
composites.what: Toolkit for the Analysis of Composite Structures: a parallel finite-element code for analysis and gradient-based design of thin-walled aerospace structures.

composites.name: CalculiX
composites.what: Finite-element solver with layered composite shell and solid elements for laminate stress analysis.

composites.name: Code_Aster
composites.what: EDF finite-element solver with multilayer shell, damage and cohesive-zone (delamination) models.

composites.name: pyNastran
composites.what: Python library for building and post-processing NASTRAN composite (PCOMP) models and ply results.

safety.name: SCRAM
safety.what: Probabilistic risk analysis tool for fault trees, event trees, common-cause failures and uncertainty analysis.

safety.name: reliability
safety.what: Python library for reliability engineering and survival analysis, including life-data distribution fitting.

safety.name: lifelines
safety.what: Python survival analysis library for estimating failure-time distributions from censored data.

safety.name: Storm
safety.what: Probabilistic model checker for analysing reliability and safety properties of Markov models.

safety.name: OSATE
safety.what: Open Source AADL Tool Environment for modelling and analysing the architecture of embedded and avionics systems.

mdao.name: OpenMDAO
mdao.what: NASA framework for multidisciplinary analysis and optimisation with efficient analytic derivatives across coupled models.

mdao.name: GEMSEO
mdao.what: Python library for automating multidisciplinary design studies, including MDO formulations and design-space exploration.

mdao.name: pyOptSparse
mdao.what: Python framework that gives one interface to many gradient-based and gradient-free nonlinear optimisers.

mdao.name: Dakota
mdao.what: Sandia toolkit for optimisation, parameter studies, calibration and uncertainty quantification around any simulation code.

mdao.name: pymoo
mdao.what: Python library of single- and multi-objective optimisation algorithms such as NSGA-II.

mdao.name: SMT
mdao.what: Surrogate Modeling Toolbox: Python library of kriging and other surrogate models with derivative support.

mdao.name: CPACS
mdao.what: Common Parametric Aircraft Configuration Schema: DLR data format for exchanging aircraft design data between analysis tools.

mission.name: Dymos
mission.what: Optimal-control library on OpenMDAO for trajectory optimisation using collocation methods.

mission.name: Aviary
mission.what: NASA aircraft analysis, design and optimisation tool built on OpenMDAO, coupling aircraft sizing with mission analysis.

mission.name: CasADi
mission.what: Symbolic framework for automatic differentiation and numerical optimal control.

mission.name: Ipopt
mission.what: Interior-point solver for large-scale nonlinear optimisation, a common back-end for trajectory optimisation.

mission.name: OpenAP
mission.what: Open aircraft performance model and Python toolkit for estimating thrust, drag, fuel consumption and emissions of common airliners.

mission.name: BlueSky
mission.what: Open air traffic simulator from TU Delft for flying and analysing aircraft trajectories and traffic scenarios.

mission.name: traffic
mission.what: Python toolbox for processing and analysing recorded aircraft trajectories and airspace data.

vvuq.name: Dakota
vvuq.what: Sandia toolkit for optimisation, parameter studies, calibration and uncertainty quantification around any simulation code.

vvuq.name: OpenTURNS
vvuq.what: Library for the treatment of uncertainties, risks and statistics: probabilistic modelling, propagation, sensitivity and reliability methods.

vvuq.name: UQpy
vvuq.what: Python toolbox for uncertainty quantification covering sampling, surrogates, reliability and inference.

vvuq.name: Chaospy
vvuq.what: Python toolbox for uncertainty quantification with polynomial chaos expansions and Monte Carlo methods.

vvuq.name: SALib
vvuq.what: Python library of global sensitivity analysis methods such as Sobol, Morris and FAST.

vvuq.name: EasyVVUQ
vvuq.what: Python library that organises verification, validation and uncertainty quantification campaigns for simulation codes.

economics.name: AeroMAPS
economics.what: Framework for assessing prospective air-transport scenarios, with models for energy, emissions and airline, manufacturer and carbon-tax costs.

economics.name: SUAVE
economics.what: Conceptual aircraft design environment that includes industrial and operating cost estimation methods alongside mission analysis.

economics.name: OpenAP
economics.what: Aircraft performance toolkit whose fuel-burn and emission estimates feed operating-cost calculations.

economics.name: numpy-financial
economics.what: Small Python library of financial functions such as net present value, internal rate of return and loan payments.
